mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customer WHERE deleted = true ORDER BY deleted_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET deleted = true, deleted_time = #{deletedTime}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
UPDATE customer SET deleted = false, deleted_time = NULL, deleted_by = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM customer WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = true
DELETE FROM customer WHERE deleted = true AND deleted_time < #{expireBefore}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customer WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
